CustomField.description: Pulls account email domain from website capture field.
CustomField.formula: IF(FIND("/", Website_Domain_Capture__c )>0, LOWER(LEFT(Website_Domain_Capture__c, FIND("/", Website_Domain_Capture__c) - 1)), LOWER(Website_Domain_Capture__c))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pulls account email domain from website capture field.
CustomField.label: Website Email Domain
